title: Stop! The e-stop
about: The gantry shares the bed with you. See how it is stopped in the middle of a job, and what happens to the job.

steps.title: Robot: start a long job
steps.why: Probing every planted cell takes a while: a good job to interrupt.

steps.title: You: press the e-stop
steps.why: The gantry holds where it is at once and ignores every target. The running job is aborted, never resumed by itself.

steps.title: You: release it
steps.why: Only a person releases the e-stop. The gantry waits for a new job you confirm; it does not pick the old one up again.
